units.text: On the front of the breast badge, in the centre of the heptagon, is an applied golden coat of arms of the City of Moscow, consisting of its principal element, Saint George the Victorious on horseback striking the dragon with a spear, on a heraldic shield covered in dark red enamel. A ribbon bearing the inscription ‘LAUREATE OF THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW’ surrounds the coat of arms. In the lower part of the breast badge, the ends of the ribbon diverge and extend beyond the heptagon.

units.text: The reverse of the breast badge bears the name of the Prize of the City of Moscow and the year it was awarded. The breast badge is attached by an eyelet and ring to a rectangular suspension bar framed at the bottom with a decorative cord. The bar is covered with a dark red moiré ribbon. On the front of the bar, an applied laurel branch runs diagonally upward from left to right. The reverse of the bar has a device for fastening it to clothing.
